tools.name: search_accommodations
tools.description: Finds last-minute hotels in a city, neighborhood, airport, or landmark for tonight or specified upcoming dates. Dates are represented by dateIntent tonight or by checkinDate and checkoutDate. Supports occupancy, price, stars, guest score, property type, amenities, cancellation, and sort filters. Ret

tools.name: get_accommodation_details
tools.description: Returns undated facts for one identified RoomLast property ID, including address, description, photos, amenities, check-in and checkout times, star rating, and guest-review data. Availability, room offers, prices, breakfast, and cancellation terms are not included.

tools.name: get_accommodation_offers
tools.description: Returns one named or identified hotel's live room offers for tonight or specified upcoming dates. Dates are represented by dateIntent tonight or by checkinDate and checkoutDate. Results include room types, photos, breakfast, refundability, cancellation terms, public-rate comparisons, masked RoomLast
